reason: User explicitly requested a Chinese small-model alternative. Existing development data show a Chinese-only separation margin; this protocol tests a minimal single-model method rather than adding a large verifier.

model.queryPrefix: 为这个句子生成表示以用于检索相关文章：

development.scope: Only train/calibration scoring and selection. The separation was observed retrospectively, so neither split is an independent test.
development.languageRule: Chinese unrelated negatives contain Script=Han; report Chinese30/10 and English30/10 separately, never dilute a Chinese-only rate with English negatives.
development.thresholdRule: Use train zh-zh semantic positive top1 scores and train Chinese pure-OOD top1 scores. If maximum negative is below minimum positive, use their midpoint rounded to two decimals if that stays strictly above max negative and at or below min positive; otherwise use the exact midpoint. If no margin exists, this single threshold method is RED. No new threshold sweep or holdout access.

execution.strong: Preserve source-authenticated same-field phrase/all effective terms/all complete IDs. Choose global eligible K before strong exemption; no refill.
execution.weak: For each weak lexical or metadata field, use its fixed best raw-coarse original96/16 window in a complete eligible pool, and apply the same fixed cosine threshold independently. No sibling borrowing or alternate-window search after rejection.
execution.source: Original case, actual owner/row/window/credential/permission/cancellation checks before encoding and at final disclosure; statistics and vector caches never serve as authorization or references.
execution.unknown: Incomplete encoding, unsupported source, truncation or deadline remains unknown/partial, not a confident negative.
execution.verifier: No separate scalar verifier process or probability bridge; cosine is not a probability or answerability score.

qualification.chineseOnly: Chinese semantic Recall@5>=.90, MRR>=.75, Chinese pure-OOD FPR<=.05, exact-ID preservation and complete coverage; actual consumer citations, privacy, lifecycle and latency still required.
qualification.independence: Freeze method before authoring a new independent Chinese fixture. Neither calibration scores nor this observed margin prove independent quality. Preserve existing v6 unconsumed for its distinct full-language candidate purpose.
qualification.fullLanguage: Existing3.1 Chinese/English/cross-language requirements remain unchanged and pending. A Chinese-only result must not be reported as full-language qualification or permission to silently change the default.
qualification.resources: Current24,451,175B model assets plus40,533,717B shared text dependencies are not final ZIP size. Peak single-worker RSS is not incremental desktop RAM. Measure the actual selected deployment.
